results.title: Families Refusing Conscription Fees Denied Subsidized Cooking Oil in Myanmar’s Mon State
results.description: Local junta-appointed administrators in Mon State’s Paung Township are denying low-income families access to subsidized palm oil if they fail to pay monthly military conscription fees, residents said.

results.title: Kejriwal to Hold Town Hall in Goa Against E20 Petrol, Alleges Vehicle Damage and Rising Sugar Prices
results.description: Panaji: AAP national convenor Arvind Kejriwal on Monday announced that he would participate in a Town Hall in Goa on Tuesday to raise concerns over the use of E20 petrol, alleging that the fuel blend was damaging vehicle engines and affecting mileage.
